{{Quote|He's been directly or indirectly responsible for planetary genocide. the destruction of things like the Museum of Light on Tandis Four|[[Kornell Divini]], about [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="JH">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>}}
The '''Museum of Light''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] that was located on [[Tandis Four]].<ref name="JH" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], destroyed the museum,<ref name="JH" /> to demoralize [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalists]] in the surrounding region. [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]] considered this to be the grimmest episode of the conflict.<ref name="Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>
